name: hydrant
description: Hydrant's MCP server and the hydrant skill: read a Hydrant workspace before touching it, write with request IDs and versions, read back, and report what actually happened.

interface.shortDescription: Issue tracking your agent can't sweet-talk
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to one Hydrant workspace you approve in the browser, with no more access than your role. The hydrant skill carries the house rules: read the whole thread first, keep request IDs and versions on every write, read it back, and say what actually happened.
defaultPrompt: What's assigned to me in Hydrant, and what's blocking it?
